---
title: "figure2_variant_caller_boxplot"
output: html_document
---

===============
# General Setup
===============

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

# Read in files
```{r}
megatable <- read.csv("../data/pangenome_project_megatable.csv")

strelka <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Reference", "Strelka_Precision", "Strelka_Recall", "Strelka_F1_Score")]
somatic <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Reference", "Somatic_Precision", "Somatic_Recall", "Somatic_F1_Score")]
mutect <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Reference", "Mutect_Precision", "Mutect_Recall", "Mutect_F1_Score")]

strelka$Variant_Caller <- "Strelka"
somatic$Variant_Caller <- "SomaticSniper"
mutect$Variant_Caller <- "Mutect2"
```

# Setup
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

caller_colors <- c("#e5d9ff", "#f1a1ff", "#9c8fff")
black_colors <- c("black", "black", "black")
```

# Useful functions
```{r}
rename_col <- function(df) {
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Recall$", colnames(df))] <- "Recall"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Precision$", colnames(df))] <- "Precision"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_F1_Score$", colnames(df))] <- "F1_Score"
  return(df)
}
```


===============
# Pangenome
===============

# Filter only Pangenome data 
```{r}
strelka_pan <- strelka[strelka$Reference == "Pangenome", ]
somatic_pan <- somatic[somatic$Reference == "Pangenome", ]
mutect_pan <- mutect[mutect$Reference == "Pangenome", ]

strelka_pan <- rename_col(strelka_pan)
somatic_pan <- rename_col(somatic_pan)
mutect_pan <- rename_col(mutect_pan)

combined_pan <- rbind(strelka_pan, somatic_pan, mutect_pan)
combined_pan$F1_Score <- as.numeric(combined_pan$F1_Score)
combined_pan$Precision <- as.numeric(combined_pan$Precision)
combined_pan$Recall <- as.numeric(combined_pan$Recall)
combined_pan$Variant_Caller <- factor(
  combined_pan$Variant_Caller,
  levels = c("SomaticSniper", "Strelka", "Mutect2")
)
```

# Plot Pangenome
```{r}
combined_long_pan <- data.frame(
  Donor_ID = rep(combined_pan$Donor_ID, times = 3),
  Variant_Caller = rep(combined_pan$Variant_Caller, times = 3),
  Metric = rep(c("F1_Score", "Precision", "Recall"), each = nrow(combined_pan)),
  Value  = c(combined_pan$F1_Score, combined_pan$Precision, combined_pan$Recall)
)

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.8)
jitterdodge <- position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8)
```


```{r}
set.seed(1)
boxplot_pan <- ggplot(combined_long_pan, aes(Metric, Value, fill=Variant_Caller)) + 
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = 1.5,      
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,   
    alpha = 0.2,                
    fill = "grey"                
  ) +
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar", 
    width = 0.3, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 0.6,
    position = dodge) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 1,
    color = "black",
    size = 0.6,
    position = dodge) +
  labs(
#    title = "Pangenome", 
    x = element_blank(), 
    y = "Metric Percentage (%)") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "F1_Score" = "F1 Score",
    "Precision" = "Precision",
    "Recall" = "Recall"))  +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = caller_colors,
    name = "Variant Caller") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = black_colors,
    name = "Variant Caller",
    labels = c(
        "SomaticSniper" = "Somatic Sniper",
        "Strelka" = "Strelka",
        "Mutect2" = "Mutect2")) +
  geom_jitter(
    size = 2,
    shape = 21,
    aes(color = Variant_Caller),
    fill = NA,
    alpha = 0.9,
    position = jitterdodge) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 22,
                                             size = 6,
                                             fill = caller_colors, 
                                             color = "black")), 
    fill  = "none") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.91, 0.15),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    # panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
    # panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
    # panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.y.left   = element_line(color = "black")
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5, y = Inf,
    label = "Pangenome",
    size = 7,
    color = "black",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 2
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(1.5, 2.5), 
    linetype = "dashed", 
    color = "grey", 
    size = 0.6)

boxplot_pan
```

# Save Pangenome Plot
```{r}
ggsave("./plot/figure1_variant_caller_boxplot_pangenome.pdf", boxplot_pan, width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
